$comment: Shape of one rule file (rules/<name>.yaml). The checks that need more than a schema (ownership conventions, pointer roots, sample payloads) are in packages/rules-cli.

name.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

owner.description: The agent that is woken by a matching event (agent/<id>). Its own event handler decides what to do.

selector.description: Glob over the topic; * matches any run of characters including dots.

path.description: JSON pointer into the event payload (/data/..., /topic, /source, /key, /classification, /verified, /depth).

wake.description: A rule wakes its owner: always true.

status.description: Leave out to keep whatever the domain has; see rules/README.md.
